The '''2013–14 Czech First League''', known as the [[Gambrinus (beer)|Gambrinus]] liga for sponsorship reasons, was the 21st season of the [[Czech Republic]]'s top-tier [[Association football|football]] league. The season began on 19 July 2013 and ended on 31 May 2014. [[AC Sparta Prague|Sparta Prague]] won their 36th title on 4 May 2014, after defending champions [[FC Viktoria Plzeň|Plzeň]] drew against [[FK Baumit Jablonec|Jablonec]]. They ended the season with a Czech league record of 79 points out of a possible 90, winning all of their home games, and losing only one away game and drawing a further four.<ref>{{cite web|title=Sparta přehrála Jihlavu a vytvořila bodový rekord ligy|url=http://www.sportovninoviny.cz/fotbal/1liga/zpravy/sparta-prehrala-jihlavu-a-vytvorila-bodovy-rekord-ligy/1085942|work=Sportovní noviny|access-date=31 May 2014}}</ref> [[SK Sigma Olomouc|Sigma Olomouc]] and [[1. SC Znojmo|Znojmo]] were relegated, the latter having played its top flight debut, and the former having played in every Czech first league season since its establishment in 1993.

==Teams==
[[FC Hradec Králové|Hradec Králové]] and [[SK Dynamo České Budějovice|České Budějovice]] were relegated to the [[2013–14 Czech 2. Liga]] after finishing last and second to last, respectively, in the [[2012–13 Czech First League|2012–13 season]]. Hradec Králové therefore returned to the second tier after three seasons in the top league, while České Budějovice left after a seven-year spell in the top flight.

The relegated teams were replaced by [[2012–13 Czech 2. Liga|2012–13 2. Liga]] winners [[1. SC Znojmo|Znojmo]] and runners-up [[Bohemians 1905]]. Bohemians thus returned to the top flight after a one-year absence. Znojmo, having never played in the top flight before, made their top-league début.<ref name=znojmodebut>{{cite news|url=http://fotbal.idnes.cz/znojmo-uspelo-s-odvolanim-a-bude-hrat-prvni-ligu-fug-/fotbal.aspx?c=A130614_112853_fotbal_vl|title=Znojmo uspělo s odvoláním, v cestě do první ligy už klubu nic nebrání|language=cs|publisher=idnes.cz|date=14 June 2013|access-date=19 June 2013}}</ref>
